base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 102 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: Bar 1 begins on an eighth-note upbeat into beat 1 with an ascending leap from F#4 to B4 and C#5, peaking on D5 on beat 2 before a sixteenth-note triplet descent (C#5-B4-A4) landing on F#4 on beat 4. Bar 2 lands on an expressive minor sixth G4 on beat 1, resolving down stepwise through F#4 and E4 to settle gently on D4 on beat 4 with subtle chest-voice vibrato..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar in B minor with an upright felt piano softly echoing high chord extensions (F#5 and D5). Subtle analogue room tape hiss in the stereo background.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Soft kick on beats 1 and 3 paired with a dry wooden rim click on 2 and 4. Flatwound electric bass plays rounded root-to-fifth lines, supporting continuous fingerpicked acoustic guitar.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Bowed upright bass creates a warm low-end swell. Shaker enters on running eighth notes while acoustic guitar shifts from fingerpicking to light palm-muted strums.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Open strummed steel-string acoustic guitars spread wide. Dry, low-tuned snare hits on beats 2 and 4. Clean electric guitar on neck pickup doubles the vocal hook melody with light spring reverb.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Drums drop to a single decaying crash cymbal. Electric guitar plays the tail of the hook melody over a solitary fingerpicked acoustic guitar figure.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Drum kit resumes a muted rim-click groove. Bass line becomes more melodic with descending fills. A vintage Rhodes piano enters softly with low-register reedy pads.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Kick moves to steady quarter notes with floor tom accents on beat 4. Electric guitar adds swelling volume-pedal chords while bowed strings increase harmonic tension.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full acoustic rhythm section with driving snare backbeat and eighth-note hi-hat. Overdriven electric guitar doubles the lead hook. Bass guitar locks tightly into the kick with walking octaves.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Dynamic strip-down: drums drop out entirely except for a distant mallet roll on a dark ride cymbal. Piano and fingerpicked guitar hold fragile chords while Cmaj7 adds a fleeting Neapolitan color.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Full band climax. Open ride cymbal and punchy live snare drive the groove. Layered acoustic strums and twin telecaster guitars articulate the hook with vocal harmonies supporting lines 3 and 4.
timeline.chords: Bm - G - D - A - Bm - G - Em7 - F#sus4

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Drums decrescendo to a solitary heartbeat kick. Electric guitar echoes the opening hook motif in rubato phrasing, resolving into a ringing Bm(add9) acoustic chord that fades into room air.
